pages.title: Colour Changing Nee Doh
pages.description: Shop Colour Changing NeeDoh at Cogs Toys & Games Ireland. A squishy fidget toy that shifts colour as you squeeze it. Ages 3+.
pages.ld_description:
Colour Changing Nee Doh


Mesmerizing stress ball that changes colour when squeezed, creating a fun and calming visual effect 🌈


Filled with Nee Doh’s signature soft, squishy, non-toxic compound that always returns to its original shape


Encourages sensory exploration, focus, and emotional regulation, making it ideal for kids and adults


Provides stress relief and calming tactile input, perfect for reducing anxiety or boosting concentration


Durable and safe for everyday use; made with child-friendly materials and free from harmful chemicals


Portable size, great for travel, classrooms, therapy sessions, or quiet play at home


Recommended for ages 3 and up, making it suitable for a wide range of users


Watch the magic unfold in your hand as the Colour Changing Nee Doh reacts to touch and pressure with shifting hues—offering both a deeply satisfying squish and a relaxing visual escape.
